response.text:

- **Mobile contract (FunkNetz Smart M)** with FunkNetz Mobil GmbH — cancellation must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]; the current term otherwise runs to 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
